svg.text: Miniforge Target — T3. Built-vs-Unbuilt Delta & Contradiction Register
the honesty panel — self-reported completion, ground-truth status, and the nine recorded contradictions the rethink must resolve
NORMATIVE SPEC COMPLETION (self-reported)
"governs nothing at 50%" — the N11 capsule verdict (design review)
Standing recommendations (design review)
1. Machine-checked conformance manifest — stop the spec
corpus becoming aspiration rather than contract
2. Finish the N11 capsule BEFORE Fleet expansion
3. Adopt guarded-transitions RFC (FSM owns its decisions)
Tenancy note (for the adoption rethink)
Tenancy is essentially ABSENT as a first-class construct:
no tenant/org entity anywhere; Fleet has org-wide limits +
pack visibility only; multi-operator explicitly deferred.
The tenancy-ownership-access v1.5 adoption starts from zero.
SUBSYSTEM STATUS BOARD (ground truth)
BUILT — works, dogfoods
SDLC engine: workflow FSM · DAG executor · phases · agents · llm
governance: policy-pack · gates · evidence-bundle · event-stream
pr-lifecycle · pr-train · release-executor · self-healing
console core: 729 Rust tests · adapters · state store · TUI + Swift
contracts/ Transit goldens · Data Foundry connectors + cursors
minibench first slice · fleet-server base · knowledge-shared ·
auto-apply · dag-graph · approvals · privacy-gates
PARTIAL — real but thin, or in progress
Phase D control path (control-plane-client crate exists; wiring in progress)
N11 capsule ~50% (phase gates themselves: wired, fail-closed)
Fleet governance comps = in-memory 3-clj stubs: authz ·
conflict-detection · resource-management · policy-distribution · analytics
HTTP LLM streaming (falls back)
workbench-orchestration-adapter (no CLI wiring)
WorktreeInbox read-side: claude-code only; bash write-only
SPEC-ONLY — no meaningful code
miniforge-run-specs repo: EMPTY (run model lives in N-specs)
N7 OPSV workflow · lineage tracking (schema slot only)
deployment domain: no provision/configure/deploy/validate phases;
zero infra wrappers (terraform·helm·kubectl·crossplane·argocd·zarf);
zero cloud config connectors (AWS SSM/SM · GCP SM · Azure KV · Vault)
N12 enterprise: SSO/SCIM · signing · private registries · org OCI policy
fleet-web / api-server / fleet-dashboard (1–2 clj stubs)
native shells beyond macOS (Linux/Windows deferred)
CONTRADICTION REGISTER — nine on record
1 · two derivers of supervisory truth
Clojure supervisory-state is "the single emitter" — but N5-delta-3 requires Rust to derive DecisionCard/AttentionItem locally. Both can't hold.
2 · entity contract is convention, not contract
Rust supervisory-entities is a hand-written mirror: no schema-version; serde silently drops unknown fields — the silent-downgrade class.
3 · "Rust does NOT manage agents" vs bare-agent launch
N5-delta-2 §2A.5 vs delta-3 §2.2 — resolved by amendment, but the base text still contradicts unless read together.
4 · governance fails OPEN
gate passes non-critical violations (vocab mismatch + severity-less scans); unknown gates and empty packs degrade to pass.
5 · three severity vocabularies, none enforced
packs (:critical/:major/:minor/:info) vs supervisory (:info…:critical) vs deployment (:critical…:low) — no single source of truth.
6 · two orchestrators, nested
N1 assumes a "dumb" LLM fed context-packs; Claude Code IS an orchestrator — restraining the inner one via prose is the worst design point.
7 · WorktreeInbox dead-drop
decisions written to .miniforge/inbox.jsonl; read-side normative only for claude-code — bash agents stay write-only ("measures writes, not reads").
8 · spec surface outruns the floor
13 normative specs + deltas at ~45–50% implementation; new deltas minted per dogfood incident — corpus risks becoming aspiration, not contract.
9 · the FSM doesn't own its decisions
routing lives outside the (state,event)→state table; redirect budget wired to one channel of two → 3h40m runaway. RFC written, unadopted.
Why this panel exists
The tenancy/policy adoption (the rethink) starts HERE: contradictions 1, 2, 4, and 5 are exactly the class of problem the clause-label / decision-envelope /
attested-contract machinery from tenancy-ownership-access v1.5 resolves — and the tenancy note (left) says the ownership layer starts from a blank page.
sources: Critical Review and Miniforge Gaps · miniforge-design-review-2026-06-10 · miniforge-control-design-review-2026-06-10 · miniforge-governance-audit-2026-07-05 · ROADMAP
